import math

x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
best = float('inf')
ansx = ansy = 0

i = 1
while i < n + 1:
    num = int((x * i) // y)
    diff = abs(x / y - num / i)
    if diff < best:
        best = diff
        ansx = num
        ansy = i

    num = math.ceil((x * i) / y)
    diff = abs(x / y - num / i)
    if diff < best:
        best = diff
        ansx = num
        ansy = i

    i += 1

print(f"{int(ansx)}/{int(ansy)}")
</translated_code>
